name: Soul Emperor
intro: Passionate developer creating modern, interactive, and user-friendly digital experiences.

about.intro: I'm a developer who enjoys turning ideas into polished, responsive products, from pixel-perfect interfaces to the server logic behind them.
about.journey: My journey started with HTML and CSS, grew into JavaScript, and moved on to PHP, Laravel and MySQL for full-stack work.
about.education: Software Enginering / diploma, Aptech Metro Star Gate, 3 years.
about.interests: Full-stack web applications, interactive UI, clean architecture and developer experience.
about.goals: Ship production-grade products, deepen backend skills, and keep learning every month.

availability: Open to freelance projects, internships and full-time roles. I usually reply within 24 hours.

services.d: Responsive, animated interfaces built with HTML, CSS, JavaScript and Bootstrap.
Laravel and PHP applications with clean MVC structure and MySQL databases.
Dark, modern layouts with strong typography, motion and attention to detail.
Static sites on GitHub Pages and full-stack apps on external hosting.

journey.d: Wrote my first HTML and CSS pages and fell in love with building things people can see.
Added interactivity, APIs and small projects, and learned Git and GitHub.
Moved into PHP, Laravel and MySQL and shipped my first complete applications.
Focused on performance, design quality and larger, real-world projects.

edu.d: Aptech Metro Star Gate. Currently studying web development, object-oriented programming, databases, and building full-stack projects.
D.J. Sindh Government Science College, Karachi (BIEK). Completed higher secondary education with a focus on Computer Science and Mathematics.

strengths.d: I break big problems into small, testable steps.
Clear updates, honest estimates and friendly collaboration.
I pick up new tools quickly and apply them to real projects.

process.d: Understand goals, audience and constraints before writing code.
Sketch layouts, pick type and colour, and plan the data.
Develop in small steps with Git, reviewing as I go.
Test on real devices, optimise and deploy.

faq.q: What kind of projects do you take on?
faq.a: Portfolio and business websites, dashboards, and full-stack web apps built with Laravel and MySQL.

faq.q: How long does a typical project take?
faq.a: A landing page takes days, a full-stack app takes weeks. I share a timeline after we talk.

faq.q: Do you work with existing codebases?
faq.a: Yes. I can fix bugs, add features or modernise an existing PHP or JavaScript project.
Send a message with a short description of your idea and I will reply with questions and next steps.
